Question 1
?

Find an equation of the plane that contains the point P(1,−3,4) and is perpendicular to the vector n=8i+27j.

a
r⋅(8i+27j)=−1
b
r⋅(8i+27j)=8−3
c
r⋅(8i+27j)=i−3j+4k
d
r⋅(i−3j+4k)=1
e
r⋅(i−3j+4k)=8i+27j
